$comment: CENTRAL-owned build-size regression baseline for tools/repo-health/build-size.mjs.
Regenerate only when CENTRAL has reviewed the product change that moved these
numbers. `metrics` is fingerprinted (sha256 over a stable serialisation); editing
it without re-running --write-baseline makes the tool fail closed.
productTreeNote: CAE-05 commits touch only tools/repo-health/** and docs/engineering/**. src/**, supabase/**, db/**, package.json, package-lock.json, next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, postcss.config.mjs are byte-identical to fce4fe735b4ad249ba1c183adab087d25b524721 (accepted CAE-04), so the build output measured here is that product tree's.

measurementDefinitions.static.rawBytes: sum of raw bytes of every file under .next/static/** except source maps (.map)
measurementDefinitions.js.rawBytes: sum of raw bytes of .js/.mjs files under .next/static/**
measurementDefinitions.css.rawBytes: sum of raw bytes of .css files under .next/static/**
measurementDefinitions.media.rawBytes: sum of raw bytes of all other .next/static/** files (fonts, images, etc.)
measurementDefinitions.largestJsBytes: size of the single largest .js file under .next/static/** (filenames are content-hashed; compared by size)
measurementDefinitions.largestCssBytes: size of the single largest .css file under .next/static/**
measurementDefinitions.routes: sorted union of routes-manifest.json staticRoutes[].page + dynamicRoutes[].page
measurementDefinitions.informational.gzip: Node zlib.gzipSync per file, summed — NOT the CDN transfer size, NOT part of the gate
measurementDefinitions.informational.perRouteJsBytes: UNAVAILABLE — this Turbopack build emits no app-build-manifest.json
measurementDefinitions.informational.serverBuildRawBytes: bytes under .next/server/** — not browser-shipped, determinism not gate-validated
